about_the_game:
The game offers extensive customization of your character in both modes Freemode and ArcadeMode, allowing you to choose from dozens of weapons, including swords, maces, shields and bows; different outfits and choose your own attack animations. All this will affect you both aesthetically and in your way of fighting.

Freemode will allow the players to build their own story in a vast world, where they can join guilds and player-lead factions, exploring the provinces while using a free building construction system, weapon creation, diplomacy and much more.

Arcade mode currently has FIVE game modes:
· Team Deathmatch 2 to 4 Teams
· Free For All
· Capture the Flag
· Last Team Standing 2 to 4 Teams
· Defense

This modes can be played on four maps of different sizes, which will allow larger battles on larger maps.

content_descriptors.notes: May contain violence and gore due to blood and sound of characters taking damage and dying.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64 bits
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i3-9100F / AMD Ryzen™ 3 3200G
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 1050
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection

short_description: Blood Oath: When the Sword Rises has FreeMode and ArcadeMode, in which you will put yourself in the shoes of a medieval soldier who will take his course in an open world, fighting for your lord, the interests of your guild, or just engaging in small skirmishes with up to 32 players in ArcadeMode.
supported_languages: English, Italian, Spanish - Spain, Hungarian, Polish, German, Norwegian, Russian
